final_fixture_delta.assessment: Each makeValue cleanup now explicitly TryUnmap on the exact held staging before Value.Release, making original-source late-nil panic cleanup independent of candidate readState. Cleanup remains subtest-scoped, before the corresponding device is released.

ValueReadSync(nil,nil,v) causes the original nil-first Go refusal path instead of entering a nil native device. Four original-compatible refusal checks are inspected; an earlier raw failure remains historical and is not physical-hardware fault evidence.

contract_assessment: Whole map batches preflight owner identity, staging size/usage/liveness, Idle state and duplicate buffer pointers before mapping. Channels isolate callback delivery from owner mutation and replacement resources.
Allocation refusal preserves old staging; automatic upload/reuse routes return read-staging repair errors. A prior valid upload is explicitly not atomically rolled back.
Buffer-backed legacy StorageTexture retains its original buffer route; actual texture-backed values use separate Texture methods.
Vars.Config preserves its native validation operation and immediately releases the temporary layout references, leaving pipeline-created layouts distinct.
limitations: Read-only source/hash/in-memory patch replay review only; no Go, prepare, build, native GPU, window/UI, provider or Git execution by the reviewer.
No final receipt or pending run is certified here; prior candidate tiny headless execution is separate supporting author evidence and predates the final cleanup-only test delta.
One serialized initially-unmapped owner is required. Copied Value ownership, caller-native maps, arbitrary concurrency and broad abnormal owner recovery are outside the contract.
The post-Poll callback wait is bounded; the underlying blocking Poll is unchanged and has no new physical-loss deadline.
No native/GPU heap reclamation, physical fault injection, sustained latency/endurance, complete compiler/SDK closure or full Mac acceptance is implied.
